rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: The Speaker reported that on 30 August 2011 the House received from Prime Minister Kan (菅内閣総理大臣) a notice that the Cabinet had decided to resign en masse.

rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: The House designated 野田佳彦 as Prime Minister on 30 August 2011: 308 of 476 votes (majority 239; one ballot without a designee's name invalid); 谷垣禎一 118, 山口那津男 21, 志位和夫 9, 福島みずほ 6, 渡辺喜美 5, 平沼赳夫 4, 小沢一郎 1, 海江田万里 1, 鳩山邦夫 1, 横粂勝仁 1. The sitting opened at 13:02 and recessed at 13:38.

bounded_scope: Head-of-government observations for CLAUDE-C01-13 only (stacked on CLAUDE-C01-12).
